header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Om Parkash H. Karmani advocate for the petitioner
body: Mr. Neel Parkash, D.P.G a/w S.H.O P.S Sindhri.

Learned A.A.G has filed parawise comments of respondents No.2 to 4, which are taken on record. The petitioner has filed this petition only for issuance of directions to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioner.
S.H.O P.S Sindhri is present and undertakes that legal protection will be provided to the petitioner as and when required.
In view of above, instant petition is disposed of with direction to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioners as and when required and to act strictly in accordance with law.
